tok 1.0 "Hiring"

pool org "Organisation"
  lane dept "Department"
    start need "Need for a new hire identified"
  lane hr "HR"
    task jd "Create a job description"
    task post "Post the job on job boards"
    task collect "Collect resumes"
    task screen "Screen resumes"
    task phone "Conduct phone interviews"
    task select "Select candidates"
    xor pref "Candidate preference?"
    task inperson "Interview in person"
    task virtual "Interview virtually"
    xor joini
    task choose "Choose a candidate"
    task offer "Extend an offer"
    xor neg "Negotiate salary?"
    task negotiate "Negotiate salary"
    xor accjoin
    task accept "Receive offer acceptance"
    and ob
    task paper "Complete paperwork"
    task orient "Hold orientation"
    task train "Provide training"
    and obdone
    task integrate "Integrate the new hire into the team"
    end done "New hire integrated"

flow need -> jd -> post -> collect -> screen -> phone -> select -> pref
flow pref -> inperson "in person"
flow pref -> virtual "virtual"
flow inperson -> joini
flow virtual -> joini
flow joini -> choose -> offer -> neg
flow neg -> negotiate "yes"
flow neg -> accjoin "no"
flow negotiate -> accjoin
flow accjoin -> accept -> ob
flow ob -> paper
flow ob -> orient
flow ob -> train
flow paper -> obdone
flow orient -> obdone
flow train -> obdone
flow obdone -> integrate -> done
